company.shortDescription: Endpoint Health is a precision immunology company
company.description: Endpoint Health is a precision immunology company that is breaking the efficacy barrier of traditional pharma's “one-size-fits-all” drug development strategy by developing precision therapies with outsized efficacy potential in autoimmune and inflammatory conditions.  They’re accomplishing this by leveraging OMNAI, their proprietary AI-powered patient discovery platform, to identify and match high-potential therapies to the patients most likely to respond.

aiResearchSummary.text: Endpoint Health is focused on precision immunology, specifically developing methods for identifying therapy recommendations for subjects with dysregulated immune responses, such as sepsis. This involves analyzing quantitative expression of biomarkers to classify subjects and tailor treatments accordingly. Their research aims to enhance diagnostic and therapeutic approaches for managing immune-related conditions.
